goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Implemented raw pre-normalization classification: only the exact root-relative path and exact HTTP origin/path classify private, with hostname case equivalence only. Added exhaustive rejection coverage for whitespace, scheme/port aliases, dot segments, backslashes, encoded hostnames, credentials, query/fragment, wrong origins/paths, and malformed inputs. Focused browser proofs confirmed uppercase-host private behavior and dot-segment fail-closed public behavior. Full tests, lint, builds, desktop/mobile browser, public-off controls, artifact identity, and diff hygiene pass.
deviations: One TypeScript test-narrowing failure was fixed within the first bounded attempt.
